title: Unified Field UI
notes: Adds a shared MITHRIL notice, confirmation, and stacked toast system.
Shows the active document name and persistent Saved on device, Unsynced changes, Syncing, Cloud synced, Offline, or Read only status.
Makes Save + Next the primary field action and keeps field actions reachable while entering hole data.
Docks the touch keypad on the right in tablet landscape and at the bottom in portrait.
Standardizes Drill Log and Shot Diagram hole-entry context without changing calculations, storage, cloud contracts, or permissions.
Preserves the verified m40.7.1 cross-device cloud-loading fix and m40.6.2 iPad touch behavior.
